name: App.test.tsx
summary: Default Create React App smoke test that renders the App component and asserts a 'learn react' link is present; a leftover CRA template test not updated for this project's actual UI.

name: App.tsx
summary: Root application component that sets up React Router and routes the single '/' path to the UploadPage component.

name: index.tsx
summary: CRA bootstrap file that mounts the App component into the DOM root element inside React.StrictMode and kicks off web-vitals reporting.

name: UploadPage.tsx
summary: Main and only application page: lets a user submit a YouTube URL, triggers course generation via the backend API, streams live progress over Server-Sent Events, and renders the resulting course content, quiz, and retention-plan tabs using Material UI.

name: reportWebVitals.ts
summary: CRA performance-measurement helper that lazily loads the web-vitals library and reports Core Web Vitals metrics (CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, TTFB) to a caller-supplied callback.

name: api.ts
summary: Thin Axios-based API client that kicks off course generation on the backend by POSTing a YouTube video URL to /api/generate-course, with the base URL configurable via REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty package marker that makes the api directory importable as the backend.app.api Python package.

name: frame_extraction.py
summary: Video processing pipeline that downloads a YouTube video via yt-dlp, detects scene boundaries, extracts and optimizes keyframes, loads them into a FiftyOne dataset to select visually unique frames, and aligns the selected frames to transcript timestamps.

name: routes.py
summary: Core FastAPI router for the course-generation feature: exposes endpoints to kick off course generation from a YouTube URL and to stream progress over SSE, orchestrating transcript fetching (with Whisper fallback), frame extraction, the LangGraph agent pipeline, S3 frame uploads, and course persistence.

name: s3_utils.py
summary: Initializes a boto3 S3 (or S3-compatible, e.g. MinIO) client from environment variables and provides a helper to upload a local keyframe file to the configured bucket, returning its public URL.

name: main.py
summary: FastAPI application entry point: creates the app, configures CORS, mounts the local frames directory as static files, and registers the API router under /api.

name: crud.py
summary: Async CRUD layer for the courses table: creates a new Course record (with IntegrityError handling for duplicate video IDs), updates a course's status, and fetches a course by YouTube video ID.

name: database.py
summary: Configures the SQLAlchemy async engine and session factory from the DATABASE_URL environment variable, and exposes a test_connection helper used to verify database connectivity at startup.

name: models.py
summary: Defines the SQLAlchemy declarative Base and the Course ORM model storing generated course data (transcript, structured content, course content with S3 frame URLs, quiz content, retention plan, and status).

name: init_db.py
summary: One-shot database initializer run by the backend-init compose service: polls the configured DATABASE_URL until Postgres accepts connections, then idempotently creates any missing tables via Base.metadata.create_all.

name: Dockerfile
summary: Single-stage Docker build for the FastAPI + LangGraph backend, pinned to Python 3.10-slim for numpy/numba wheel compatibility, installing CPU-only PyTorch from a dedicated index before the rest of requirements.txt, then copying in the app and scripts directories and launching via scripts/start.sh on port 8000.

name: .dockerignore
summary: Excludes caches, virtualenvs, git metadata, and generated artifacts (frames/, transcripts/, logs) from the backend Docker build context to keep image builds small and deterministic.

name: .dockerignore
summary: Excludes node_modules, build output, .git, and log/OS artifacts from the Docker build context for the frontend image, keeping image builds fast and reproducible.

name: Dockerfile
summary: Multi-stage Docker build that compiles the CRA (react-scripts 5) frontend with node:20-alpine and serves the resulting static bundle from nginx:1.27-alpine on port 80.

name: build
summary: Build stage on node:20-alpine: installs dependencies with npm ci --legacy-peer-deps, copies public/src/tsconfig.json, bakes REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL, and runs npm run build to produce the static bundle.

name: nginx
summary: Runtime stage on nginx:1.27-alpine: installs a custom nginx.conf and copies the built static bundle from the build stage, exposing port 80 to serve the frontend.

name: .env.example
summary: Template environment file listing required and optional variables for the docker-compose stack: LLM API keys (Gemini, Groq), Postgres credentials, MinIO/S3 storage settings, and the frontend API base URL.

name: README.md
summary: Project README for the Docker-Compose launcher of the YouTube Video to Structured Course Generator, covering quick start, usage, .env configuration, changes made vs. the upstream project, troubleshooting, and manual (non-Docker) development instructions.

name: docker-compose.yml
summary: Docker Compose stack definition that launches the full local application: Postgres for persistence, MinIO for S3-compatible frame storage plus a bucket-init job, Jaeger for tracing, the FastAPI/LangGraph backend with a DB-init job, and the nginx-served React frontend.

name: package.json
summary: Minimal root-level npm manifest declaring a single dependency, remark-breaks, likely used for markdown line-break rendering somewhere in the project's tooling or frontend.

name: postgres
summary: Postgres 16 Alpine database service providing course/JSONB persistence, with a healthcheck gating dependent services.

name: minio
summary: MinIO service providing local S3-compatible object storage for extracted video frame images, exposing the S3 API and web console.

name: minio-init
summary: One-shot bootstrap job that waits for MinIO to be healthy, creates the storage bucket, and sets it to public-read for local image serving.

name: jaeger
summary: Jaeger all-in-one service acting as the OpenTelemetry/OTLP trace collector and UI for the stack.

name: backend
summary: FastAPI + LangGraph agent backend service, built from ./backend, wired to Postgres, MinIO/S3, and Jaeger via environment variables, exposed on port 8000.

name: backend-init
summary: One-shot database schema initialization job that runs scripts/init_db.py against the backend image to create the courses table once Postgres is healthy.

name: frontend
summary: React SPA built from ./frontend and served by nginx on port 3000, configured with the backend API base URL at build time.

name: README.md
summary: Default Create React App boilerplate README for the frontend, documenting the standard npm scripts (start, test, build, eject) and links to CRA/React learning resources.

name: package.json
summary: npm manifest for the React/TypeScript frontend, declaring dependencies (React 19, MUI, axios, react-router-dom, react-player, react-markdown, dompurify) and the CRA-based start/build/test/eject scripts.

name: tsconfig.json
summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the frontend, enabling standard CRA-generated strict/JSX/module settings and scoping compilation to the src directory.

name: index.html
summary: HTML shell template for the React frontend (Create React App), providing the root mount div, manifest/favicon links, and Google Fonts (Inter) preconnect tags into which the bundled JS is injected at build time.

name: manifest.json
summary: Web app manifest declaring PWA metadata (app name, icons, theme/background colors, start URL) for when the frontend is installed on a mobile or desktop device.

name: robots.txt
summary: Search engine crawler policy allowing all user agents unrestricted access to the site (no paths disallowed).

name: project.yml
summary: Serena MCP project configuration defining language servers, workspace folders, ignored paths, tool exclusions, and default operating modes for the deep-harn repository.

name: .understandignore
summary: Template ignore-pattern file for the Understand-Anything analysis tool, listing commented-out glob patterns (from .gitignore conventions and common test-file naming) that can be uncommented to exclude paths from codebase analysis.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty Python package marker file that makes backend/app importable as a package.

name: agentic.py
summary: LangGraph agent pipeline that turns a lecture transcript and extracted video frames into a structured multi-module course — orchestrating Gemini/Groq LLM calls (with tenacity retry and OpenTelemetry tracing) across content structuring, frame selection, course content generation, quiz creation, and spaced-retention plan design.

name: utils.py
summary: Small utility module providing LLM-output JSON cleanup (stripping markdown code fences) and base64 image encoding helpers used by the agentic course-generation pipeline.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty Python package marker file for the backend/app/db package.

name: broadcaster.py
summary: In-memory Server-Sent Events broadcaster (MessageAnnouncer) that manages per-job async queues for progress subscribers, publishes JSON-formatted progress events, and tracks job status for the course-generation SSE stream.

name: requirements.txt
summary: Python dependency manifest for the backend service, pinning FastAPI/uvicorn, LangChain/LangGraph with Gemini and Groq integrations, video/audio processing libraries (yt-dlp, opencv, whisper, scenedetect, fiftyone), OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and PostgreSQL/S3 clients, with inline notes explaining resolved version conflicts.

name: start.sh
summary: Container entrypoint script that runs a preflight import check of the heavy dependency stack (fiftyone, the LangGraph agent, the FastAPI app) before launching uvicorn as a single worker on port 8000, since in-memory progress queues require a single process.

name: nginx.conf
summary: Nginx server configuration serving the built React SPA — enables gzip compression, sets long-lived immutable caching for hashed static assets, and falls back all unmatched routes to index.html for client-side routing.

name: App.css
summary: Default Create React App stylesheet for the root App component, providing the boilerplate centered layout, spinning logo animation, and header styling from the CRA template.

name: index.css
summary: Global base stylesheet setting the default system font stack and monospace code font for the whole React application.

name: react-app-env.d.ts
summary: Create React App TypeScript ambient type declaration reference file enabling CRA's built-in type definitions (e.g. for static asset imports).

name: setupTests.ts
summary: Jest test setup file that imports jest-dom's custom DOM matchers (e.g. toHaveTextContent) for use across the frontend test suite.

name: tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
summary: Auto-generated TypeScript incremental build cache file tracking compiled file state for faster rebuilds; not hand-maintained source.
